prompt:
<FIRST_FRAME> <LAST_FRAME> Continuous, unbroken single shot from a flying camera, no scene cuts, no change of shot. The shot starts looking up at an open blue sky with white clouds, with only the very tip of the tower's antenna at the bottom center, and ends on a high aerial view of Daegu's 83 Tower above a wide city.
The camera starts tilting down very gently and smoothly picks up speed, then keeps tilting down at a calm, steady speed while moving forward, with no pause and no jump. First the red and white antenna of the tower rises into the frame from the bottom, then its observation deck and its shaft, then the forested hill at its base and the wide dense city of apartment blocks spread out below, with mountains on the horizon in the upper part of the frame and real depth parallax. Near the end the downward tilt slows gently, and the camera keeps moving until the very last frame. The tower stays in the center of the frame.
Clear, bright daylight with a clean blue sky and white clouds.
The tower keeps exactly the same design throughout: a red and white lattice antenna on top, a small cap, an upper observation ring, angled support struts and a large main observation deck with horizontal bands of windows. The tower, buildings and roads stay rigid and never appear, disappear or change shape. Stable level horizon. Photorealistic aerial footage shot on a high-end cinema camera: crisp, clear, transparent air with high visibility and no haze, sharp fine detail in the trees and buildings, natural contrast. No text, no aircraft in the frame. Quiet ambient wind sound only, no music, no dialogue.
